Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: Nick is the ONE BLUE SPROTO in reference image 1. Preserve the cobalt-blue broad head/body, red triangular side/back spikes, small yellow top spike, large bulging yellow eyes with large RED irises and small black pupils, yellow muzzle/chin frame, enormous expressive red lips and visible cream square teeth. His hands are RED BARE SKIN with separately visible fingers, thumbs, nails and knuckles. These are NOT gloves. NO BOXING GLOVES, NO FIGHTING GLOVES, no mittens, gauntlets, wrist wraps or hand coverings in ANY pose. Open palms and fingered fists retain normal hand proportions, never oversized padded fists. Extend the cropped lower body conservatively: blue torso/arms, simple opaque dark navy shorts, two blue legs rooted low at pelvis and simple rounded blue feet. Keep the large expressive anxious face. Exclude black image padding and background. No extra character. Image 1 is the original Nick face; image 2 is his approved combat sheet. Match the EXACT head, bare red skin hands with visible fingers, shorts, blue torso and blue feet from image 2. No gloves or hand coverings of any kind.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. In every drawing hands are uncovered and anatomical, with visible fingers/thumbs and small knuckles. Red hands are skin, never rounded boxing gloves. No wrist cuffs. When fists close, retain clear finger divisions. Every glove-like drawing is a defect.
Strict exact grid count; generous empty magenta gutters around every complete body.
